summary: TransAlta Corporation filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, attaching a press release dated April 29, 2026. The press release announces the declaration of quarterly dividends on its Cumulative Redeemable Rate Reset First Preferred Shares for the period March 31, 2026 to June 30, 2026. Dividend rates range from 4.221% to 6.894%, with per-share amounts from $0.26309 to $0.43088 (Canadian dollars). Record date is June 1, 2026; payment date is June 30, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned.
